meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of deepTools suite and NGS analysis methods; normalization formulas and genome sizes match established references

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for NGS data processing with experiment-specific guidance (ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq)

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established NGS analysis practices with validated normalization methods (RPGC, CPM, RPKM) and standard QC metrics

code_usability.detail: All command examples are syntactically correct with proper parameters and validation scripts provided

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of NGS workflows including BAM/bigWig processing, QC, visualization, with excellent reference organization and helper scripts

reliability.note: Excellent troubleshooting with validation script, common error solutions, and file checking guidance; proactive error prevention emphasized

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (413 lines) with clear workflow guidance, comprehensive references, and helper scripts for validation and generation

agent_usability.note: Exceptional 'When to Use This Skill' with natural language triggers; detailed 'Handling User Requests' section with interaction patterns; workflow generator for automation

human_usability.note: Clear installation with conda/PyPI options; quick start guide with validation; workflow generator for template creation; comprehensive best practices by experiment type

security.note: File validation before operations; output path management implicit; minor: lacks explicit guidance on PHI/sensitive genomic data handling

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 1.2, clear license (BSD), comprehensive references (4 files), helper scripts (2), assets, and effective genome size tables

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools and samtools integration; workflow generator enables automation; example interactions provided; minor: output format schemas not fully specified

recommendations.title: Add inline examples for key visualization parameters
recommendations.problem: computeMatrix and plotHeatmap parameters delegated entirely to reference files without inline examples
recommendations.root_cause: Main doc focuses on workflow structure rather than parameter details
recommendations.fix: Add brief inline example showing computeMatrix reference-point --referencePoint TSS and plotHeatmap --colorMap parameter to complement reference documentation

recommendations.title: Add batch processing pattern for multi-sample workflows
recommendations.problem: Multi-sample comparison mentioned but no bash loop or batch script pattern shown
recommendations.root_cause: Documentation assumes users will adapt single-sample commands
recommendations.fix: Add example showing 'for bam in *.bam; do bamCoverage ...; done' pattern or reference to workflow_generator for batch template creation

recommendations.title: Add guidance for sensitive genomic data handling
recommendations.problem: No discussion of PHI or sensitive genomic data considerations
recommendations.root_cause: Documentation focuses on technical operations without addressing data sensitivity
recommendations.fix: Add security note about PHI in genomic data, avoiding accidental sharing of BAM files with identifiable information, and institutional data management requirements
